cards.card_text: It's a span long and a span wide, with four rows of gemstones set in gold, from a ruby, a topaz and an emerald on top down to a beryl, an onyx and a jasper.
cards.verse_text: It must be square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
cards.snippet: It must be square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.

cards.card_text: Folded double, it's a square, a span long and a span wide.
cards.verse_text: It was square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.
cards.snippet: It was square when folded over double, a span long and a span wide.

cards.card_text: Then a champion walks out of the Philistine camp: Goliath, from Gath, six cubits and a span tall.
cards.verse_text: He was six cubits and a span in height,
cards.snippet: He was six cubits and a span in height,

cards.card_text: And may his years span many generations, baker.
cards.verse_text: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.
cards.snippet: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.

cards.card_text: Isaiah says Tyre will be forgotten for ___ years, the span of a king's life.
cards.verse_text: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years—the span of a king’s life.
cards.snippet: At that time Tyre will be forgotten for seventy years—the span of a king’s life.

cards.card_text: The first one: “Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, or marked off the heavens with the span of his hand?”
cards.verse_text: Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, or marked off the heavens with the span of his hand?
cards.snippet: …the hollow of his hand, or marked off the heavens with the span of his hand?

cards.card_text: After His suffering, Jesus appears to the apostles over a span of forty days, and He speaks about the kingdom of God.
cards.verse_text: He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
cards.snippet: He appeared to them over a span of forty days and spoke about the kingdom of God.
